coordinate_convention: Continuous source pixel bounds from0; pixel centers(i+.5,j+.5); world logical coordinate=pixel/2.

probes.pixel_formula: round(center_rgb + ((x+.5-left)/width-.5)*x_slope + ((y+.5-top)/height-.5)*y_slope), clipped0..255; x/y integer pixel indices.
probes.meaning: Two-dimensional nonperiodic coarse RGB code. Each tile/color/ramp is a known input; local output correspondence remains conditional on visibility/uniqueness gates. No fine dot coding.
